name: S2D C2 2024 multistation strict final PR28 admission source
# Runs only on explicit manual dispatch or validated science-request branch push.
# No main-branch push, PR or merge triggers.
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/verify-s2d-c2-final-admission-20261017
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/s2d-c2-final-admission-20261017.yml
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: s2d-c2-pr28-143h-exact-source-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  g35-double-meteorology-original-calpuff:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    steps:
      - name: Checkout current CTEAS-next scientific source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 2
      # This QA branch adds ONLY the workflow to the PR #28 source commit.
      # Checkout its exact parent to run all authentic source and preserve the
      # existing untouched C2 original/native A/B/C/D scientific gates.
      - name: Verify immutable PR28 source and exclude workflow-only commit from physics
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD)" = ".github/workflows/s2d-c2-final-admission-20261017.yml"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "8e5e918e31bed459a8cf47641c2e49130a23f10a"
          git checkout --detach "8e5e918e31bed459a8cf47641c2e49130a23f10a"
          science_sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          test "$science_sha" = "8e5e918e31bed459a8cf47641c2e49130a23f10a"
          echo "SCIENCE_SOURCE_SHA=$science_sha" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "SCIENCE_EXECUTION_HEAD=$science_sha"
          echo "SCIENCE_WORKFLOW_CASE=C2_2024_12x12_2SS_2US"
          echo "C2_SELECTED_PR28_SOURCE=PINNED"
      - name: Checkout frozen original CTEAS inputs and vendor for ephemeral local use
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: RRain001/CTEAS
          ref: dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13
          path: original-cteas
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Restore and check local-only original vendor dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git -C original-cteas rev-parse HEAD)" = dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13
          python3 scripts/migration/configure_external_assets.py --source-repo original-cteas
          python3 scripts/migration/configure_external_assets.py --check
          test -s engine/vendor/src/CALMET_v6.5.0_L150223/calmet.for
          test -s engine/vendor/src/CALPUFF_v7.2.1_L150618/calpuff.for
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SCIENCE_SOURCE_SHA"
          echo "C2_ORIGINAL_SOURCE_RESTORED_EPHEMERALLY=PASS"
      - name: Prepare original and native compiler tools
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends g++-12 gfortran-11 gfortran libgdal-dev cmake
          gfortran-11 --version | head -1
          g++-12 --version | head -1
      - name: Confirm current P6 and P7 use the identical CTEAS-next commit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          test "$sha" = "$SCIENCE_SOURCE_SHA"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SCIENCE_SOURCE_SHA"
          {
            echo "CTEAS_NEXT_SOURCE_SHA=$sha"
            echo "P6_NATIVE_SOURCE_SHA=$sha"
            echo "P7_NATIVE_SOURCE_SHA=$sha"
            echo "ORIGINAL_CTEAS_SOURCE_SHA=dfad99a78ed84d655e21411c9d25eb0d2583bf13"
            echo "SAME_CURRENT_P6_P7_HEAD=YES"
          } > "$RUNNER_TEMP/integration-physical-source-identity.txt"
          sha256sum engine/vendor/src/CALMET_v6.5.0_L150223/calmet.for engine/vendor/src/CALPUFF_v7.2.1_L150618/calpuff.for > "$RUNNER_TEMP/original-vendor-source-sha256.txt"
          echo "C2_SAME_HEAD_SOURCE=PASS HEAD=$sha"
      - name: Build frozen PR63 multi-station source and true G14 physical scheduler
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cmake -S native_cpp/modules/p6_calmet -B "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/g35-build" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/g35-build" --parallel 2 --target \
            cteas_p6g_g19_file_backed_case_tests \
            cteas_p6g_g21_source_fradj_probe \
            cteas_p6g_g34b_six_hour_selected_gate
          cmake -S native_cpp/modules/p6_calmet/p6e -B "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/p6e-comparator" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          cmake --build "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/p6e-comparator" --parallel 2 --target p6e_calmet_dat21

      - name: Generate genuine 143h original-format 2SS/2US source once for both CALMET solvers
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/g35-build/cteas_p6g_g19_file_backed_case_tests" \
            --export-case project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/run/met/met.inp \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source" --fradj-stress --daylight-first-hour --hours 143
          test "$(grep -c '^ 6201 ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source/UP1.DAT")" -eq 15
          test "$(grep -c '^ 6201 ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source/UP2.DAT")" -eq 15
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/g35-build/cteas_p6g_g21_source_fradj_probe" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source/met.inp" "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source/GEO.DAT" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source/SURF.DAT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source/UP1.DAT" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source/UP2.DAT" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/g35-first-hour-native.csv" \
            --source-stage "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/g35-first-hour-stage.dat"

      - name: Execute unchanged original CALMET 6.5.0 for all 143 hours
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 native_cpp/modules/p6_calmet/reference/g31_run_literal_original_calmet_multisite.py \
            --mode Release --hours 143 --source "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source" \
            --source-clock "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/g35-first-hour-native.csv" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/original"
          test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/original/original-met.dat"

      - name: Execute PR63 real native G14 143h and strict 6,435-field CALMET gate
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/g35-build/cteas_p6g_g34b_six_hour_selected_gate" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source/met.inp" "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source/GEO.DAT" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source/SURF.DAT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source/UP1.DAT" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/source/UP2.DAT" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/native-met.dat" --hours 143 \
            | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/native-trace.log"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/p6e-comparator/p6e_calmet_dat21" compare \
            --reference "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/original/original-met.dat" \
            --candidate "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/native-met.dat" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/original-vs-native-45field.json"
          sha256sum "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/original/original-met.dat" \
                    "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/native-met.dat" \
            | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/dual-met-sha256.txt"
          echo 'P7_C2_DUAL_REAL_MET_READY=PASS HOURS=143 FIELDS=6435'

      - name: Run nonzero-controlled original CALPUFF A and C with SAME source inside true 12x12 grid
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 native_cpp/modules/p7_calpuff/reference/run_c2_vendor_inside_grid_pair.py \
            --pr63-root . \
            --original-met "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/original/original-met.dat" \
            --native-met "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/native-met.dat" \
            --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/internal-source-science" \
            | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/C2-vendor-pair.log"
          test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/internal-source-science/C2-A-vs-C-science.json"
          echo 'P7_C2_VENDOR_ORIGINAL_AND_PR63_MET_H3_TRANSPORT=MEASURED_NONZERO'
          echo 'P7_C2_NATIVE_P7_MULTISTATION=EVALUATING_CURRENT_MAIN'

      - name: Capture original Fortran H1 receptor 4-6 intermediates without changing puff.con
        id: vendor_stage
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2"
          python3 native_cpp/modules/p7_calpuff/reference/c2_vendor_receiver_stage_trace.py \
            --pr63-root . \
            --weather "$root/original/original-met.dat" \
            --control "$root/internal-source-science/C2-source-inside-multistation-domain.inp" \
            --baseline-con "$root/internal-source-science/A-original-calpuff.con" \
            --out "$root/H1-readonly-stage" \
            | tee "$root/C2-vendor-H1-readonly-stage.log"

      - name: Build full original-source P7 C++ COMP for the actual 2024 12x12 G35 case
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cmake -S native_cpp/modules/p7_calpuff -B "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/p7-build" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
          cmake --build "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/p7-build" --parallel 2 \
            --target cteas_p7_hefei_sixhour_native_h3_receptors_tests cteas_p7_original_native_terrain_tests
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/p7-build/cteas_p7_original_native_terrain_tests"

      - name: Protect accepted P7 2022 single-station first six hours after shared CALCPF change
        id: protected_2022
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2"
          CTEAS_P7_MAKEGEO_INP=project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/geo/makegeo/makegeo.inp \
            "$root/p7-build/cteas_p7_hefei_sixhour_native_h3_receptors_tests" \
            project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/run/met/met.dat \
            project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/run/puff/puff.inp \
            project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/run/puff/puff.con \
            > "$root/P7-2022-frozen-sixhour-protection.log" 2>&1 || {
              tail -n 80 "$root/P7-2022-frozen-sixhour-protection.log"
              exit 1
            }
          grep -F 'P7_HEFEI_REAL_6H_COMPUTATION_AND_PRECISION_DIAGNOSTIC=PASS' \
            "$root/P7-2022-frozen-sixhour-protection.log"

      - name: C2 physics preflight same original MET, first six authentic 2024 hours
        id: smoke_original
        continue-on-error: true # diagnostic run may produce real physics differences
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2"
          CTEAS_P7_INTEGRATION_C2=1 \
          CTEAS_P7_C2_H1_RECEIVER_TRACE="$root/H1-readonly-stage/C2-native-H1-receptor-4-6-stage.txt" \
          CTEAS_P7_MAKEGEO_INP=project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/geo/makegeo/makegeo.inp \
            "$root/p7-build/cteas_p7_hefei_sixhour_native_h3_receptors_tests" \
            "$root/original/original-met.dat" \
            "$root/internal-source-science/C2-source-inside-multistation-domain.inp" \
            "$root/internal-source-science/A-original-calpuff.con" \
            > "$root/C2-original-P7-first6h.log" 2>&1 || {
              tail -n 90 "$root/C2-original-P7-first6h.log"
              exit 1
            }
          grep -F 'P7_C2_NATIVE_ON_PR63_MET HOURS=6' "$root/C2-original-P7-first6h.log"

      - name: Compare read-only H1 vendor/native CALCPF stage operands
        if: always()
        id: h1_stage_compare
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/H1-readonly-stage"
          python3 native_cpp/modules/p7_calpuff/reference/c2_compare_readonly_receiver_stages.py \
            --vendor-json "$root/C2-vendor-H1-receptor-4-6-stage.json" \
            --native-trace "$root/C2-native-H1-receptor-4-6-stage.txt" \
            --out "$root/C2-vendor-native-H1-first-stage-comparison.json"

      - name: C2 same original MET true 143h B native P7 — strict 20,592 REAL4 words
        id: p7_B
        if: always() && steps.smoke_original.outcome != 'skipped'
        continue-on-error: true # still preserve real native 143h output for first-difference audit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2"
          CTEAS_P7_INTEGRATION_C2=1 \
          CTEAS_P7_PROBE_HOURS=143 \
          CTEAS_P7_NATIVE_PUFF_CON="$root/internal-source-science/B-original-met-native-p7.con" \
          CTEAS_P7_MAKEGEO_INP=project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/geo/makegeo/makegeo.inp \
            "$root/p7-build/cteas_p7_hefei_sixhour_native_h3_receptors_tests" \
            "$root/original/original-met.dat" \
            "$root/internal-source-science/C2-source-inside-multistation-domain.inp" \
            "$root/internal-source-science/A-original-calpuff.con" \
            > "$root/C2-original-MET-P7-B-143h.log" 2>&1 || {
              tail -n 100 "$root/C2-original-MET-P7-B-143h.log"
              exit 1
            }
          grep -F 'P7_C2_NATIVE_ON_PR63_MET HOURS=143 REAL4_MATCHED=20592/20592' "$root/C2-original-MET-P7-B-143h.log"

      - name: C2 same PR63 native MET true 143h D native P7 — strict 20,592 REAL4 words
        id: p7_D
        if: always() && steps.smoke_original.outcome != 'skipped'
        continue-on-error: true # same identical-MET strict gate retained at final decision
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2"
          CTEAS_P7_INTEGRATION_C2=1 \
          CTEAS_P7_PROBE_HOURS=143 \
          CTEAS_P7_NATIVE_PUFF_CON="$root/internal-source-science/D-native-met-native-p7.con" \
          CTEAS_P7_MAKEGEO_INP=project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011/geo/makegeo/makegeo.inp \
            "$root/p7-build/cteas_p7_hefei_sixhour_native_h3_receptors_tests" \
            "$root/native-met.dat" \
            "$root/internal-source-science/C2-source-inside-multistation-domain.inp" \
            "$root/internal-source-science/C-original-calpuff.con" \
            > "$root/C2-native-MET-P7-D-143h.log" 2>&1 || {
              tail -n 100 "$root/C2-native-MET-P7-D-143h.log"
              exit 1
            }
          grep -F 'P7_C2_NATIVE_ON_PR63_MET HOURS=143 REAL4_MATCHED=20592/20592' "$root/C2-native-MET-P7-D-143h.log"

      - name: Independently compare real 2024 H-3 A/B and C/D and B/D field differences
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/internal-source-science"
          cmp_py=native_cpp/modules/p7_calpuff/reference/compare_p7_hourly_concentrations.py
          if test -s "$root/B-original-met-native-p7.con"; then
            python3 "$cmp_py" \
              --a "$root/A-original-calpuff.con" --b "$root/B-original-met-native-p7.con" \
              --nx 12 --ny 12 --hours 143 --report "$root/C2-same-MET-A-vs-B.json"
          fi
          if test -s "$root/D-native-met-native-p7.con"; then
            python3 "$cmp_py" \
              --a "$root/C-original-calpuff.con" --b "$root/D-native-met-native-p7.con" \
              --nx 12 --ny 12 --hours 143 --report "$root/C2-same-MET-C-vs-D.json"
          fi
          if test -s "$root/B-original-met-native-p7.con" && test -s "$root/D-native-met-native-p7.con"; then
            python3 "$cmp_py" \
              --a "$root/B-original-met-native-p7.con" --b "$root/D-native-met-native-p7.con" \
              --nx 12 --ny 12 --hours 143 --report "$root/C2-different-MET-B-vs-D.json"
          fi

      - name: Final science gate requires genuine 143h A/B and C/D REAL4 identity
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-c2/internal-source-science"
          python3 - "$root" "${{ steps.smoke_original.outcome }}" "${{ steps.p7_B.outcome }}" "${{ steps.p7_D.outcome }}" <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          import sys
          root=Path(sys.argv[1])
          step_statuses=sys.argv[2:]
          verdict={"smoke_outcome":step_statuses[0],
                   "B_outcome":step_statuses[1],
                   "D_outcome":step_statuses[2]}
          good=all(s=="success" for s in step_statuses)
          for name in ("C2-same-MET-A-vs-B.json","C2-same-MET-C-vs-D.json"):
              path=root/name
              if not path.is_file():
                  verdict[name]="MISSING"
                  good=False
                  continue
              v=json.loads(path.read_text())
              verdict[name]={"matching_real4":v.get("matching_real4"),
                             "values":v.get("values"),
                             "bitwise_identical":v.get("bitwise_identical"),
                             "first_difference":v.get("first_difference")}
              if not (v.get("hours")==143 and v.get("values")==20592
                      and v.get("bitwise_identical") is True
                      and v.get("matching_real4")==20592):
                  good=False
          verdict["C2_ACCEPTED"]=good
          (root/"C2-final-scientific-verdict.json").write_text(
              json.dumps(verdict,indent=2)+"\n")
          print("P7_C2_143H_FOUR_ARM_SCIENTIFIC_GATE="+
                ("PASS" if good else "OPEN_OR_FAIL"))
          print(json.dumps(verdict,indent=2))
          if not good:
              sys.exit(1)
          PY

      - name: Publish independent C2 science verdicts even on an integration failure
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: cteas-next-c2-143h-science-current-head
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/integration-physical-source-identity.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/dual-met-sha256.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/original-vs-native-45field.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/C2-vendor-pair.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/internal-source-science/C2-A-vs-C-science.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/internal-source-science/C2-vendor-source-provenance.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/internal-source-science/C2-source-inside-multistation-domain.inp
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/internal-source-science/C2-same-MET-A-vs-B.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/internal-source-science/C2-same-MET-C-vs-D.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/internal-source-science/C2-different-MET-B-vs-D.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/internal-source-science/C2-final-scientific-verdict.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/C2-original-P7-first6h.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/C2-original-MET-P7-B-143h.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/C2-native-MET-P7-D-143h.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/P7-2022-frozen-sixhour-protection.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/C2-vendor-H1-readonly-stage.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/H1-readonly-stage/C2-vendor-H1-receptor-4-6-stage.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/H1-readonly-stage/C2-vendor-H1-receptor-4-6-stage.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/H1-readonly-stage/C2-native-H1-receptor-4-6-stage.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-c2/H1-readonly-stage/C2-vendor-native-H1-first-stage-comparison.json

name: S2D P7 source-pinned CLI build and negative-admission smoke
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize, ready_for_review]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/s2d-p7-native-cli.yml
      - native_cpp/modules/p7_calpuff/**
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  native-no-oracle-execution:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 105
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact PR head
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Configure and compile production P7 CLI
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cmake -S native_cpp/modules/p7_calpuff -B "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-build" \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++
          cmake --build "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-build" --parallel 2 \
            --target cteas_p7_native_hefei_2022
      - name: Build self-contained scoped MET, control and MAKEGEO staging
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          work="$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-native"
          mkdir -p "$work/input" "$work/output" "$work/audit"
          base=project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011
          cp "$base/run/met/met.dat" "$work/input/met.dat"
          cp "$base/run/puff/puff.inp" "$work/input/puff.inp"
          cp "$base/geo/makegeo/makegeo.inp" "$work/input/makegeo.inp"
          echo "b1823cda92280888d70b00961ab39486036a3086e18637fff21efb4f4b237d30  $work/input/met.dat" | sha256sum -c -
          echo "cf5cca70cb75b1aac92f86fdc100500e901a8b904d056c73b2330175793532bc  $work/input/puff.inp" | sha256sum -c -
          echo "e87b166346abe1c16136a790cda3acffdec6e29d9fb558ab2c9738ef426238b7  $work/input/makegeo.inp" | sha256sum -c -
          # Source reference files absent from this isolated execution path:
          # without original CON/DGM available in the source checkout either,
          # production CLI cannot accidentally consult those oracle binaries.
          rm -f "$base/run/puff/puff.con"
          find native_cpp/modules/p7_calpuff/reference -type f -name '*.bin' -delete

    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize, ready_for_review]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/s2d-p7-native-cli.yml
      - native_cpp/modules/p7_calpuff/**
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  native-no-oracle-execution:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 105
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact PR head
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Configure and compile production P7 CLI
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cmake -S native_cpp/modules/p7_calpuff -B "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-build" \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=g++
          cmake --build "$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-build" --parallel 2 \
            --target cteas_p7_native_hefei_2022
      - name: Build self-contained scoped MET, control and MAKEGEO staging
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          work="$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-native"
          mkdir -p "$work/input" "$work/output" "$work/audit"
          base=project/cases/hefei5km_2022_reference_case_20261011
          cp "$base/run/met/met.dat" "$work/input/met.dat"
          cp "$base/run/puff/puff.inp" "$work/input/puff.inp"
          cp "$base/geo/makegeo/makegeo.inp" "$work/input/makegeo.inp"
          echo "b1823cda92280888d70b00961ab39486036a3086e18637fff21efb4f4b237d30  $work/input/met.dat" | sha256sum -c -
          echo "cf5cca70cb75b1aac92f86fdc100500e901a8b904d056c73b2330175793532bc  $work/input/puff.inp" | sha256sum -c -
          echo "e87b166346abe1c16136a790cda3acffdec6e29d9fb558ab2c9738ef426238b7  $work/input/makegeo.inp" | sha256sum -c -
          # Source reference files absent from this isolated execution path:
          # without original CON/DGM available in the source checkout either,
          # production CLI cannot accidentally consult those oracle binaries.
          rm -f "$base/run/puff/puff.con"
          find native_cpp/modules/p7_calpuff/reference -type f -name '*.bin' -delete
          test ! -e "$base/run/puff/puff.con"
          ! find native_cpp/modules/p7_calpuff/reference -type f -name '*.bin' | grep -q .
          if find "$work" -iname '*.con' -o -iname '*dgm*' | grep -q .; then
            echo "UNEXPECTED_ORIGINAL_ORACLE_IN_INPUT_STAGE";exit 1
          fi
          echo "ORIGINAL_CON_DGM_PHYSICALLY_ABSENT=PASS"
      - name: Deny bad CLI geometry/hours and nonexistent input
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          work="$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-native"
          exe="$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-build/cteas_p7_native_hefei_2022"
          control="$work/input/puff.inp"
          geo="$work/input/makegeo.inp"
          met="$work/input/met.dat"
          test ! -e "$work/output/bad.con"
          if "$exe" --met "$met" --control "$control" --makegeo "$geo" --output "$work/output/bad.con" --hours 144 > "$work/audit/reject-144.stdout" 2>&1; then
            echo "INCORRECTLY_ACCEPTED_144H";exit 1
          fi
          test ! -e "$work/output/bad.con"
          if "$exe" --met "$work/input/not-present.dat" --control "$control" --makegeo "$geo" --output "$work/output/bad.con" --hours 1 > "$work/audit/reject-missing.stdout" 2>&1; then
            echo "INCORRECTLY_ACCEPTED_MISSING_MET";exit 1
          fi
          test ! -e "$work/output/bad.con"
          echo "P7-PREEXISTING-CON-MUST-NOT-BE-TOUCHED" > "$work/output/preexisting.con"
          cp "$work/output/preexisting.con" "$work/audit/expected-preexisting.txt"
          if "$exe" --met "$met" --control "$control" --makegeo "$geo" --output "$work/output/preexisting.con" --hours 1 > "$work/audit/reject-existing.stdout" 2>&1; then
            echo "INCORRECTLY_OVERWROTE_EXISTING_CON";exit 1
          fi
          cmp "$work/output/preexisting.con" "$work/audit/expected-preexisting.txt"
          echo "P7_NATIVE_OUTPUT_EXISTING_NO_CLOBBER=PASS"
          echo "partial-in-progress" > "$work/output/pre-existing-stage.con.cteas-partial"
          if "$exe" --met "$met" --control "$control" --makegeo "$geo" --output "$work/output/pre-existing-stage.con" --hours 1 > "$work/audit/reject-partial.stdout" 2>&1; then
            echo "INCORRECTLY_ACCEPTED_EXISTING_STAGED_OUTPUT";exit 1
          fi
          test ! -e "$work/output/pre-existing-stage.con"
          grep -q 'P7_NATIVE_OUTPUT_OR_PARTIAL_ALREADY_EXISTS' "$work/audit/reject-partial.stdout"
          echo "P7_NATIVE_STALE_PARTIAL_FAIL_CLOSED=PASS"
          echo "P7_NATIVE_INVALID_INPUT_NEGATIVES=PASS"
      - name: Real no-oracle P7 1h 6h and 143h H3 production executes
        timeout-minutes: 75
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          work="$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-native"
          exe="$RUNNER_TEMP/p7-build/cteas_p7_native_hefei_2022"
          for hours in 1 6 143; do
            "$exe" --met "$work/input/met.dat" --control "$work/input/puff.inp" \
              --makegeo "$work/input/makegeo.inp" \
              --output "$work/output/native-${hours}h.con" --hours "$hours" \
              > "$work/audit/native-${hours}h.log" 2> "$work/audit/native-${hours}h.err" || {
                echo "P7_NATIVE_NO_ORACLE_EXECUTION_FAIL_HOURS=$hours"
                tail -n 60 "$work/audit/native-${hours}h.log" || true
                cat "$work/audit/native-${hours}h.err" || true
                exit 1
              }
            grep "P7_NATIVE_NO_ORIGINAL_CON_DGM=PASS HOURS=$hours" "$work/audit/native-${hours}h.log"
            grep "H3_VALUES=$((hours*2500))" "$work/audit/native-${hours}h.log"
            test -s "$work/output/native-${hours}h.con"
            test ! -e "$work/output/native-${hours}h.con.cteas-partial"
            sha256sum "$work/output/native-${hours}h.con" >> "$work/audit/sha256.txt"
          done
          echo "P7_NATIVE_1_6_143H_NO_ORIGINAL_CON_DGM=PASS"
      - name: Verify true product timestamps and 143h H3 with independent file parser
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json,struct,os
          from pathlib import Path
          root=Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'p7-native'
          results={}
          for hours in (1,6,143):
              filename=root/'output'/f'native-{hours}h.con'
              raw=filename.read_bytes()
              i=0
              frames=[]
              while i<len(raw):
                  if i+8>len(raw):raise ValueError("truncated Fortran framing")
                  n=struct.unpack_from('<I',raw,i)[0]
                  if i+8+n>len(raw):raise ValueError("payload beyond EOF")
                  if struct.unpack_from('<I',raw,i+4+n)[0]!=n:
                      raise ValueError("bad Fortran record end marker")
                  frames.append(raw[i+4:i+4+n])
                  i+=n+8
              # 3218 embedded WROUT1 comment records + 8 framing/control
              # records precede the 3 hourly records; total 3226+3*h.
              assert len(frames)==3226+3*hours,(hours,len(frames))
              fields=[v for v in frames if len(v)==15+4*2500 and v[:3]==b'H-3']
              assert len(fields)==hours,(hours,len(fields))
              total_positive=0
              for field in fields:
                  vals=struct.unpack_from('<2500f',field,15)
                  total_positive+=sum(v>0 for v in vals)
              assert total_positive>0
              results[str(hours)]={'records':len(frames),'h3_fields':len(fields),
                                   'positive_values':total_positive,'output_bytes':len(raw)}
          (root/'audit'/'p7-native-output-physical-fields.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
          print("P7_NATIVE_WROUT1_INDEPENDENT_143H=PASS",results)
          PY
      - name: Upload bounded scientific audit records, not binary CON or original model data
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: s2d-standalone-p7-no-oracle-audit
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-native/audit/*.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-native/audit/*.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-native/audit/*.err
            ${{ runner.temp }}/p7-native/audit/*.json

            --puff-control "$case/run/puff/puff.inp" \
            --original-met "$case/run/met/met.dat" \
            --native-met "$root/native-p6/native_causal_independent_header_calmet.dat" \
            --original-puff-con "$case/run/puff/puff.con" \
            --p6-helper native_cpp/modules/p6_calmet/p6f/tests/verify_original_calpuff_reads_written_calmet.py \

            --out "$root/results" > "$root/audit/original-calpuff-A-C.log" 2>&1 || {

            --makegeo "$root/native-p7-input/makegeo.inp" \

          test -s "$root/results/D-new-native-met-standalone-native-p7.con"
          sha256sum "$root/results/"*.con > "$root/audit/C-D-con-sha256.txt"

          print("S2D_NATIVE_P6_TO_NO_ORACLE_NATIVE_P7_VS_UNMODIFIED_ORIGINAL=PASS_SCOPED")
